`door`: `POST /api/login {user, password}` at the process `domain`.
`door`: both fields are strings (otherwise 400 `{error: "bad body", detail}`).
`door`: the door neither sets nor reads a cookie.
`via`: there is no CORS — the page does not call another origin.
`token`: the domain token contract «The token», the row person (the fields of the person token).
`token`: the token key\nof the holder (current of the set); `until` = `exp`.

Ordinary login is unchanged, and keep/kind token issuance is not changed by this login-specific origin.

`answer`: no token,\nno `Set-Cookie`.

`journal`: a form refusal (400, 413) — without a line.
`domain/grants/<cluster>` is at the holder; `<cluster>` — a member name by the grammar of chapter 8.3\n(it need not be a member: grants are prepared before admission) or `domain`.

`line.subject`: the character `:` the grammar\nof a person's name does not let through, so a role name does not collide with a person.
`line.cap`: `none` on a line of a person or of an index key — out of form, 400 `bad line`.
`line.sub`: the presence of the manifest is not checked: grants are prepared before admission.
`line.scope`: a scope not of the forms `*`, `unit:<sub>/<id>`, `labels:<label>[,<label>…]`, `folder:<id>` with the grammars above — the line is out of form (at the door — 400 `bad line`).
`line.scope`: `labels:` on a role line — out of form.

`line.until`: at the input more than three digits\nof fraction — rounding to thousandths from the decimal notation, half away from zero (as chapter 8.1 N1.4 round): the line\nis stored and compared rounded.
`line.until`: a positive until that\nwould round to 0 this way is written 0.001 — the meaning «expired» is the same, 0 is only «no term» (the input of PUT and\nrewriting).

`line.until`: the match by (subject, cap, scope, until) and by — after rounding.
`line.by`: a line that matched a former one by (subject, cap, scope, until) keeps, at\na write of the row whole, its `by`, a new one — the name of the writer; the match — by `sub` too.
`rewrite`: a whole write of an administrator (`PUT`) replaces the document with the sent one.

`last_admin`: an unreadable\n`domain/roles/admin` — there are no administrators by the role.
`last_admin`: only unlimited ones: an administrator with a term of the account or\nof the assignment does not count, otherwise the domain would lock itself on expiry.
`last_admin`, guards of the proof: the row being written does not go as a guard (its condition is cas).
`last_admin`, without an administrator: the way back is the command `grant-admin` (N1.9).

`carry`: `roles` — the table of this member, N1.3b.
`carry`: no row: the role admin has effective assignments — `grants {doc: {lines: []}}`,\notherwise no field.
`carry`, for `anywhere`: if the former summary cannot be read, `carry` marks `anywhere` held.

`anywhere`: a copy older than `as_of + GRANT_LIFETIME` — as no field.
`carry` of `anywhere`: the sealed advertisement keeps its existing type and meaning.
`unreadable`: a line of `lines` that is out of form is skipped at a direct group and counted\nas diagnostics, the others apply.

`name` of a group: the namespace is its own: a group can be named as a person or\na role, a group does not enter grant lines.
`members`: ascending in UTF-8 bytes, without repeats.
